From: Kate Miller <kate@gridops.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Nightly 48h latency sweep — quick credit ask

Hi Irene,

We're ramping a controlled 48-hour latency sweep across our EU footprint next week (May 26-27) to validate multi-region failover logic. The test will generate sustained concurrency spikes and KV cache churn; our preliminary runs indicate we'll exhaust the trial allowance by ~36 hours unless we top up.

Can Redwood temporarily increase our sandbox allowance by 200k token-equivalents (ephemeral, non-billable) for the window? We'll isolate the tests to a dedicated project and provide the runbook and some short metrics post-run.

Quick details:
- Purpose: latency SLO validation + KV-cache evictions
- Window: 2026-05-26 18:00 UTC -> 2026-05-28 18:00 UTC (48h)
- Impact: only staging workload, no PII

I've attached the runbook and a one-page MAP. If you need a signed trial addendum, we can do that, but we'd prefer a fast provisional top-up to avoid shifting the schedule.

Thanks — appreciate any help.

Kate
Kate Miller
SRE Lead, GridOps

Hi Kate,

Thanks for the details and the runbook — appreciate the heads up. Short answer: we can usually provision a short-term allowance for controlled POCs like this.

Couple quick asks before I route to approvals:
- Confirm that you are happy with a single-use, non-rolling allowance of 200k token-equivalents (we can map tokens to your estimated requests if helpful).
- We'll need the staging project name and the exact model variant you'll pin for the test (so we can lock routing and avoid unexpected autoscaling).
- Please confirm no ingress of customer-sensitive data; a short sample prompt set would help our QA verify caching behavior.

I"m looping in Aditya for commercial sign-off and Marissa for one-off credit approval. If they're OK, I'll provision a provisional top-up by Monday.

Best,
